newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris leads Nov '96 EU cargo traffic growth table.
newsitem.headline: Paris leads Nov '96 EU cargo traffic growth table.

text.p: The Paris airports recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic in November 1996 among the EU's top cargo-handling airports, figures issued by the Aeroports de Paris (ADP) show.
Cargo traffic handled at Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports in Nov totalled 100,699 tonnes, up 9.1 percent on the same month in 1995.
The increase at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport from a year ago was the second highest at 8.8 percent taking its November freight total to 102,600 tonnes.

November 1996 cargo throughput at the three London airports (Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted), totalled 131,500 tonnes, a rise of 8.2 percent on 1995 levels while volume at Frankfurt rose 5.7 percent to 122,600 tonnes.

Over the first eleven months of 1996 Amsterdam recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic amongst the EU's top four cargo-handling airports with volume rising by 11.2 percent to 983,300 tonnes.
January-November 1996 cargo traffic handled at the London airports totalled 1,315,000 tonnes, up 5.4 percent on 1995 levels.
Frankfurt's throughput in Jan-Nov totalled 1,221,000 tonnes, up 3.1 percent on the same period last year.
January-November 1996 cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports increased by 0.4 percent on Jan-Nov 1995 to 1,013,379 tonnes. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
